children: Braveheart Bio reported an unaudited net loss of $15.0 million for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, with cash and cash equivalents of $122.8 million at quarter-end (approximately $527.3 million on an as‑adjusted basis after the August 2026 IPO). The company said its IPO proceeds are expected to fund operations into 2029 and it is advancing Phase 3 programs for BHB-1893 in obstructive and non-obstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy. Braveheart Bio also noted increases in R&D and G&A expenses tied to clinical program advancement and public-company preparations.
Net loss: $15.0 million for the three months ended June 30, 2026 (unaudited).
Net loss attributable to common stockholders: $18.6 million for the three months ended June 30, 2026 (includes $3.6 million deemed dividend related to Series A preferred stock issuance).
Research and development expense: $11.1 million for the three months ended June 30, 2026.
General and administrative expense: $4.8 million for the three months ended June 30, 2026.
Cash and cash equivalents: $122.8 million as of June 30, 2026; approximately $527.3 million on an as‑adjusted basis including $404.5 million net IPO proceeds received in August 2026.

Initiated LIONHEART-HCM, a global Phase 3, multi-region, randomized, double-blind, active-comparator-controlled trial of BHB-1893 versus metoprolol in adults with symptomatic obstructive HCM; sites are activating and patient dosing expected in 2026.
Maintains an open U.S. IND for BHB-1893 in non-obstructive HCM and expects to initiate the NOBLEHEART-HCM global Phase 3 study in the first half of 2027.

Presented Phase 2 nHCM results (with Hengrui) showing statistically significant improvements in cardiac biomarkers, functional status, exercise capacity, myocardial relaxation and cardiac remodeling; no trial drug interruptions for LVEF reductions reported in intervention cohorts.

Completed corporate financings that support clinical advancement: third closing of Series A preferred financing in April 2026 ($60.0 million gross) and an initial public offering in August 2026 (24,437,500 shares at $18.00 per share, gross proceeds ≈ $439.9 million).
